title: Great Park Ice & Fivepoint Arena
specs: Classes tailored to general skating, figure skating, and hockey paths
Off ice training designed to accelerate on ice development
Freestyle sessions have leveled types and specific skating rules
Hockey tournaments follow USA Hockey rules with specific modifications
Skaters must have appropriate GPI prerequisite to register beyond beginner level
Hockey players must wear protective equipment meeting USA Hockey requirements
Hockey players 12U and above must wear colored mouthguards
Skaters must register and pay before entering freestyle sessions and wear session sticker
Space is limited and spots fill quickly for skating classes
Teams must check in at tournament and are responsible for damages
